adjudication.notes: Contains explicit boundary by negation against automated robo-advisor functionality.

episodes.topic: Multi-currency consolidation and cross-border remittance tracking
Bank fee venting and shared expense categorization
Calm financial reflection and anti-goal on algorithmic trading
Long-term savings goals and offline cash transaction logging

goals.statement: The budget system consolidates multi-currency account holdings into a unified household monthly expenditure view.

grounding.quote: We need our family budget to consolidate multiple currency accounts into a unified monthly expenditure view.

acceptable_paraphrases: Aggregate income and spending across different currencies into a single household report.

goals.statement: The system applies daily exchange valuation updates to secondary cross-border savings holdings.

grounding.quote: that secondary account needs daily exchange valuation updates so we see the true purchasing power of our joint savings.

acceptable_paraphrases: Update foreign currency savings value daily using current foreign exchange rates.

goals.statement: Household members categorize shared living expenses to provide visibility across partners.

grounding.quote: Household members should be able to categorize shared living expenses so both partners understand where the money went.

acceptable_paraphrases: Allow family partners to assign expense categories to joint transactions.

goals.statement: Reviewing household expenditures creates feelings of calm and encouragement rather than anxiety or guilt.

grounding.quote: Reviewing monthly expenses should feel encouraging and calm rather than triggering financial guilt or panic.

acceptable_paraphrases: Financial reviews foster positive motivation rather than stress.

goals.statement: The application avoids functioning as an automated stock trading bot or robo-advisor executing financial transactions.

grounding.quote: we are definitely not building an automated stock trading bot or robo-advisor that executes transactions, because that introduces massive financial risk.

acceptable_paraphrases: Do not execute automated algorithmic investments or financial trades.

goals.statement: The system tracks progress toward multi-currency family savings goals without manual conversion recalculations.

grounding.quote: We want to track progress toward long-term family savings goals across different currencies without manual recalculation.

acceptable_paraphrases: Monitor progress toward targets across multiple currencies automatically.

traps.note: 'That secondary account' in t6 resolves to the cross-border family savings wallet introduced in t4.
Mei vents about predatory bank fees and foreign exchange markups without requesting a product goal.
Mei describes an emotional quality of calm and encouragement rather than shame or financial guilt.
Mei establishes a strict boundary rejecting automated stock trading and robo-advisor mechanics.

gaps.description: Softgoal G4 (calm and encouraging budget reviews) lacks concrete interaction design contributors.
Episode E2 contains extensive bank venting alongside a single expense categorization goal.

entailment_cases.hypothesis: The household budgeting application combines multiple currency accounts into an aggregated monthly summary.
The application connects directly to the Monetary Authority of Singapore FIX protocol feed for microsecond currency exchange rates.
The application autonomously places buy orders on high-yield international dividend stocks on behalf of users.
All household expense records must be cryptographically hashed and anchored into a proof-of-stake ledger.
